changeSet.author: inkomoko
changeSet.comment: A blank loan flag is a single disbursement, for active loans and for loans still before approval. Loans that already have more than one tranche keep the multi-tranche mark. A product that does not allow multiple disbursals cannot leave a loan marked multi-tranche.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE m_loan ml JOIN m_product_loan lp ON lp.id = ml.product_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT d.loan_id, COUNT(*) AS tranche_count FROM m_loan_disbursement_detail d GROUP BY d.loan_id ) tranche_count ON tranche_count.loan_id = ml.id SET ml.multi_disburse_loan = CASE WHEN lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 1 AND ml.multi_disburse_loan IS NULL AND COALESCE(tranche_count.tranche_count, 0) > 1 THEN 1 WHEN lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 0 THEN 0 WHEN ml.multi_disburse_loan IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE ml.multi_disburse_loan END WHERE ml.multi_disburse_loan IS NULL OR (lp.allow_multiple_disbursals = 0 AND ml.multi_disburse_loan = 1);
